text:
Aisha K: Quick idea — prototype a 'costpin' microcard in the console that shows per-route marginal token cost + cache-offset (estimated) next to the rollout slider. Main question: how do we compute cache credits without double-counting when a request pins to A but falls back to B during canary? 

Ben T: double-counting is the core risk. If fallback hits the cache populated by A, attributing the credit to both routes would inflate savings. 

Camila R: Suggest we use request lineage id (router assigns trace_id) and attribute cache hits to the origin route in that lineage. If the lineage shows fallback from A->B, mark the cache hit as belonging to A for the purpose of rollback economics. 

Evan L: lineage is ideal but we don't always have it (e.g., third-party SDKs without router header). For those, fallback heuristics: if KV-prefix match and short TTL, attribute to last writer else split credit proportionally across candidate routes based on recent write rates. 

Priya S: UI note — surface 'estimated cache credit' with a confidence bar (low/medium/high). That way product teams see both the best guess and risk of misattribution. 

Deploy Bot: deploy/canary costpin-service v0.1 -> prod-canary(5%) :rocket: 

Aisha K: Good. Operationally, we need a cheap offline job to reconcile nightly and fix persistent misattribution. Proposal: precompute nightly per-route amortized cache credits and display 'live estimate' vs 'reconciled nightly' in microcard. 

Ben T: Agreed. Also we should avoid heavy storage explosion — store only per-route per-window aggregates (route, model_sku, window_start) not per-request. 

Camila R: Implementation sketch: router adds header X-RD-Trace, KV layer records last-writer(route, trace). On read: attach last-writer if TTL<config. Then attribution SQL (nightly):
```
INSERT INTO route_cache_credits (route, window, credits)
SELECT last_writer_route, window_start, sum(credit)
FROM reads JOIN writes USING (kv_key)
WHERE read_ts BETWEEN window_start AND window_end
GROUP BY last_writer_route, window_start;
```

Evan L: For live UI estimates, add a sampling flag in router: costpin_experiment_v1=1, sample 0.5% of traffic to emit detailed lineage telemetry. We can tinker with sampling to avoid perf hit. 

Priya S: How do quotas show this? If route A has a quota and we attribute credit to A but the real cost was absorbed by B, teams might get confused. I propose two metrics: 'quota consumption' (actual tokens charged) and 'effective unit cost' (tokens / effective cache-adjusted tokens). Show both. 

Ben T: That separation is smart. Quotas stay conservative (actual charge). Effective unit cost is for decisioning in the console. 

Aisha K: Next steps: Evan add sampling flag + router header patch (small PR). Camila + Ben draft nightly reconcile job SQL and storage schema. Priya mocks microcard UI with confidence bar. We'll canary at 5% with a metrics checklist: delta in per-route unit cost, attribution stability, and no increase in 95p latency. 

Camila R: I'll schedule a follow-up sync after PRs are up. 

Ben T: :thumbsup: 

Evan L: on it — will post PR link when ready.
